To create a Ledgerly account, go to the sign-up page and enter your work email, your business name, and a password. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include one number. Ledgerly sends a verification link to your email that expires after 24 hours. If the link expires, request a new one from the sign-in page by selecting "Resend verification."

[SEC-01] How Ledgerly protects your data
Data is stored in the United States on Amazon Web Services, with backups in a second US region.

Ledgerly completes a SOC 2 Type II audit every year. Enterprise customers can request the latest report under a non-disclosure agreement from their customer success manager. Other customers can request a summary letter from support.
